periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, approximately 45 degrees relative to the medial facial axis, pointing toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval, with a height-to-width ratio significantly greater than 1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, creating a teardrop-shaped profile with the centroid shifted toward the upper half.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape across the scapular region with minimal posterior dip.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Exceedingly thin; the band manifests as a narrow transverse line rather than a broad saddle-like feature.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separation distance is approximately equal to the transverse width of the visible forehead.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semicircular and smooth with no visible flattening at the superior poles.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal band exhibits a rare phenotypic presentation of extreme narrowness, appearing more as a stroke than a full band.
